svg.text: PlutioLabs Lead Scraper v3 — MCS + Google Maps
- MCS = the LIST (who, where, verified email, certification)
- Google Maps = the AMMUNITION (reviews, hours, competitor)
Neither alone can fill the CRM. MCS-only routes 100% to Template D.
- ✅ Stage 1a/1b — MCS seed + filter (NO credentials needed)
- ⏳ Stage 1c — Google Maps keyword discovery (port from v2)
- ⏳ Stage 3a — Apify place lookup (needs Apify key, GATE 1)
v2 (VweER3SSx9Saluzx) is left untouched as the fallback.
Public JSON API, no auth, no rate limit. 5,620 UK certified installers.
Index first (923 B) → compare generated_at to last run → only pull the 4.2 MB file if changed.
Filter applies 5 fixes from the 2026-08-15 data audit
1. Prepend https:// — 83.2% of websites have no scheme
3. Never filter on region — England-only field; 929 blanks are Scotland/Wales/NI
5. Flag free-mailbox + no-Ltd as PECR high-risk → phone only
Expected output: ~4,644 emailable Ltd leads in scope.
Maps runs the SAME niche as MCS (solar + heat pump) to catch what MCS structurally cannot
see: umbrella-scheme installers, lapsed certifications, commercial-only, and businesses…
Dedupe key: normalised phone (+44…) OR website domain.
Precedence: MCS wins email / address / certification / technologies. Maps wins rating /
reviews / hours / categories / Maps URL. In both → source: 'both', sorted first.
⚠️ Maps node skips gracefully if the Apify key is missing, so the MCS branch still runs.
⚠️ v2 discarded location.lat/lng. Now captured — without it every Maps lead is invisible to
GATE 2 → _reviewStats.callComplaintRate (measure — drives A vs D mix)
All three stages are capped via Config (apifyLookupLimit, maxClaudeCalls, maxVerifyCalls) so a pilot
cannot become a full-spend run by accident. Set to 0 for unlimited after the gates pass.
Review Analysis sends the lowest-rated reviews (complaint → Template A/B) AND the highest-rated (quote
→ A-v2) in one call. Sending only lowest would kill A-v2.
Instantly is only called where it adds something — MCS already supplies an email for 100% of its rows.
Output keys are the Sheet column headers (autoMapInputData). Adding a field here requires
adding the header to the sheet or it is silently dropped.
⚠️ 17 new headers must exist in row 1 before the first run — see V3_BUILD_LOG.md.
LinkedIn message generation was removed. It contained hardcoded fabricated client results.
The WhatsApp replacement makes no performance claims until a real case study exists.
WhatsApp is a SECOND touch — export only where the Day-2 call connected. Meta bans numbers
for unsolicited business-initiated messages regardless of what PECR allows.
